amendment.decision: Separate new protocol before any project source inspection; no automatic Click fallback; no alterations to v1 inputs/results.
not_claimed: outcome-independent project selection across all possible projects
amendment.reason: The unchanged23.2-to25.0 first-parent frame has72 positions; the original3disjoint24-successor windows require75. V1 stopped and remains failed. New23-step windows fit exactly without using source or outcome information.

endpoints.comparison: Use all_validate as within-run production comparison; reference decisions are attached after production selection/state transitions. Also report symbol/file/incomplete provenance assumptions separately.
endpoints.dependence: 24 rows are12 function occurrences, potentially repeated functions/modules across three parents. Neither552 observations nor paired existence/signature claims are independent samples.
endpoints.no_performance_endpoint: Selected and actual validation calls, parent/index/reference work are recorded separately. This proposal contains no wall-time speedup benchmark and no new negative-carry optimization.
endpoints.primary: Independent-reference staleness incidence by project, parent group, syntactic claim kind and successor rank. Report unique contradicted claims and distinct first-staleness episodes separately from repeated contradicted observations.
endpoints.safety: False availability only for reference contradicted. Available-unknown, withheld-supported, parent exclusions and zero denominators stay separate. Unknown is never treated as contradiction.
endpoints.zero_staleness_rule: If no contradicted observations occur, report that outcome and a null false-availability-per-contradicted rate. Do not extend until a desired result appears.

metadata_phase.phase_rule: Seal metadata acquisition; commit exact topology before parent bytes; seal packets before AI/reference decisions; seal final inputs/driver before child bytes.

new_project.alternate_unverified_project_proposal: python-jsonschema/jsonschema may be considered only in a separate future proposal. It is not an automatic substitute if packaging fails.
new_project.relation_to_existing_cohort: A new derived development dataset; not a relabelled part of the original630. Existing Click evidence is already observed historical context, not a fresh blinded arm.
new_project.verification_status: Remote refs and72-commit first-parent frame verified. No project tree/blob/source read. Roots/function feasibility remain unknown.

parent_claim_derivation.emission: Emit one symbol_exists and one full signature_equals claim for each selected function. Keep paired-function dependence explicit.

parent_claim_derivation.insufficient_subject_rule: Fewer than four eligible subjects at any selected parent stops the proposal. Do not choose another parent or widen roots.
parent_claim_derivation.new_group_id_rule: packaging-derived- plus first12 hex characters of exact parent OID
parent_claim_derivation.origin: new_derived_parent_claim; original_candidate_id=null in cohort metadata. These are generated bounded syntactic claims, not original curated630 claims, human labels or admission records.
parent_claim_derivation.population: Enumerate the entire allowed parent package first. Record every module and every direct module-level FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef with eligibility/exclusion reason. Public and private names are included; class methods, nested/conditional definitions, duplicates, generic type parameters and ambiguous bindings are outside this bounded subject population.
parent_claim_derivation.truth_limit: Parent-derived expected signatures and an independent reference can share parser errors; deriving expected values is not independent truth. Freeze separate generator/reference implementations and all complete parent-module byte hashes.

parent_review.control_gate: All nine authored negatives must be contradicted and all three duplicate controls uncertain by each configured checker/reviewer. Failures stop expansion; no retry until expected answers appear.
parent_review.main_admission: None. Original630 claims, provenance flags, receipts, labels and heldout protocol remain unchanged.
parent_review.mode_before_packet_seal: Root selected two_fresh_AI_plus_reference: two fresh separate AI contexts per parent, six contexts total. This decision is fixed before the packet seal and any reviewer decisions.
parent_review.parent_eligibility: Reference and both fresh AI decisions must be supported. Retain all candidates, disagreements and uncertainty; record exclusions without replacements. At least four of eight eligible claims per group is a preregistered feasibility gate before child access.
parent_review.reference: Independently authored bounded syntactic reference derives facts from full immutable module bytes, never imports CAMI or generator extraction helpers, never executes project source. Shared CPython ast is disclosed.
parent_review.review_design: Two fresh separate AI contexts per parent packet. Hide coordinator answers, private case map, control class, policy output and the other reviewer. Full source can reveal project identity; no claim of project-blinding, training independence or zero historical exposure. Preserve actual model/provider identity.

provenance_contract: Use separate research symbol/file and known-incomplete inputs for these newly derived bounded claims. Full-module scope is an explicit research assumption, not a claim of runtime completeness or closure of any original630 provenance remark. Dependencies are not asserted for the bounded syntactic predicates.

resource_budget.AI_packet_limit_policy: Preflight complete-module packet size with a pinned tokenizer; at most64k input and8k output tokens per context. If a packet exceeds this budget, stop before reviewers; do not truncate a source module or replace its claims.
resource_budget.ceiling_policy: A resource stop preserves partial artifacts and failure status. It does not license dropping cases or silently shortening the registered horizon.
resource_budget.token_estimate_scope: o200k_base named research-envelope estimate, excludes harness/system/tool overhead and does not claim actual model context or billing. Responses checked after return against8k estimate.

source_configuration.parser: Pinned CPython3.12; disclose shared ast infrastructure. Source is never imported or executed.
source_configuration.rules: No automatic root expansion or file-limit change. Unsupported modes, encodings, syntax or binding hazards are reported. Feasibility and exclusions are recorded before child access.

successor_sampling.no_posthoc_replacement: No skipped merge, parse failure, weak staleness result, excluded claim, alternative branch, longer horizon or replacement project in this run. No further Click tail is triggered by a zero-contradiction result.
successor_sampling.rule: Exactly the next23 first-parent successors per frozen parent, including merges; fullorderedparent lists. Fullsnapshots of exactly72named parent/child IDs authorized only by final replay seal; side-parent trees excluded. Index/claim roots remainfixed.
